entries.en:
Before dawn today, an extraordinarily gigantic, mysterious life-form appeared above Mizuna City in Miyato Prefecture, descending slowly. Nearby residents have seen a giant humanoid weapon arrive at its projected landing point and apparently try to stop its fall.
The government also announced that, like the mysterious life-form that appeared in Miyato City, this one will be called an 'Angel.'

Mizuna City neighbors Miyato City, where giant creatures have been appearing since yesterday.

entries.en:
In Mizuna City, Miyato Prefecture, garbage must be placed at designated collection points by 8 a.m. on collection day. However, some residents put theirs out the night before, creating a dispute.
Opponents of nighttime disposal worry that it leaves collection points dirty and allows crows and other animals to scatter the garbage. Supporters include people whose daily schedules make putting it out by 8 a.m. difficult.
In response, Mizuna City commented, 'We have installed crow-proof nets and other measures, but they are not perfect. We would like to find some way to address this.'

entries.en:
Before dawn today, police received a report of a black car trying to run someone over in Mizuna City, Miyato Prefecture.
The car had reportedly already driven away by the time officers reached the scene.

The vehicle was a black luxury sedan, reportedly pursuing a young person relentlessly.
The person being chased was apparently unfamiliar to the neighborhood.
Police are searching for both the vehicle and the young person it pursued.

entries.en: Localized Violent Winds in Mizuna City
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0066.json:p0/k77; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Before dawn today, localized violent winds were observed in Mizuna City, Miyato Prefecture. Residents say powerful winds suddenly blew from the southwest, strong enough to send empty cans, flowerpots, and even car tires flying. One resident was struck by a rolling tire, injured, and taken to hospital.
The Japan Meteorological Agency says that while sudden strong winds can occur in spring, the winds in Mizuna City were a phenomenon with few precedents.

entries.en: Vending Machines Destroyed Across Mizuna City

entries.en:
Before dawn today, a report was received that five vending machines had been destroyed in Mizuna Shopping Street, Mizuna City, Miyato Prefecture.
A resident out for an early-morning walk discovered them and called 110.
Police are investigating the incident as an attempted theft targeting the cash inside.

entries.en:
Yesterday, representatives of Mizuna Shopping Street and local residents met at its community center in Mizuna City to discuss shop opening hours.
Residents want longer hours and expressed outrage that most shops currently close at 6 p.m.: 'Six is far too early. They should stay open until at least six-thirty.' The shopping street explained why it could not agree: 'If we don't close at six, we won't make it in time to watch the evening baseball games.' The discussion ended in stalemate, but shop representatives also showed flexibility, saying, 'We would like to reconsider from November onward.'

entries.en:
The enormous Angel that appeared above Mizuna City before dawn today was defeated by three giant humanoid weapons that rushed to the scene.
The Angel is believed to have descended slowly from space. Initially spherical, it eventually spread out to a size covering the entire Mizuna City area.
One humanoid weapon raced to its projected landing point and supported it to prevent its fall, while two others appeared and apparently attacked the enormous Angel.
The purple humanoid weapon supporting the Angel is thought to be the same type seen in Miyato City. The red and yellow weapons that appeared next reportedly had differently shaped heads.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0066.json:p0/k90; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Sewer construction in Mizuna Shopping Street, Mizuna City, will be extended because of the giant humanoid weapon that appeared before dawn today.
According to the city's Waterworks and Sewerage Bureau's sewer development section, new damage has been found in part of the sewer. The damaged section showed no durability problems at the previous inspection, but is believed to have been broken by the impact of the giant humanoid weapon running along the shopping street before dawn today.
Construction was originally scheduled for completion on the thirteenth of this month. It is now expected to continue until the end of next month, including inspections for further damage.

At a press conference, the head of Mizuna City's sewerage bureau bowed and said, 'We apologize for the continued inconvenience to local residents. We will proceed carefully to ensure nothing is overlooked as we work toward a better living environment for everyone, and ask for your understanding.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0066.json:p0/k94; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
In recent years, Mizuna City has struggled to deal with increasing amounts of garbage.
Some areas have produced enormous quantities over the past few years, increasing the burden on collection companies. Bulky waste such as dressers and wardrobes protrudes far into the road, severely obstructing traffic.
In a related incident, when the enormous Angel appeared above Mizuna City before dawn today, a black sedan was seen driving dangerously through dressers and wooden crates left on the road, smashing them.
One resident said, 'As a resident, I'm ashamed. People's behavior is a problem, but so are the garbage-disposal rules.'

entries.en:
A power outage occurred in part of Mizuna Shopping Street, Mizuna City, apparently caused by damage to a utility pole. Restoration work is still underway in some areas.
Fragments of black car paint were found on the damaged pole. Police are searching for the black sedan that was driving recklessly around the time the outage occurred.

A giant humanoid weapon passed through the shopping street that day, and its impact was initially thought to have damaged the pole. However, the outage began before it passed, prompting a new investigation.
